name: Zzz
summary: Three Z letters of growing size drifting up: use for sleep, boredom or snoring.

params.name: s
params.note: scale; about 430 px wide at s = 1

params.name: color
params.note: letter colour; a darker edge is added

params.name: anim
params.note: drift = Z letters float upward in turn, bob = gentle float

params.name: popIn
params.note: springs in over the first 10 frames
